purpose: Replace raw raster-value diversity with ecologically explicit Tier 1/2/3 breeding-option diversity before any demographic outcome is opened.

source_sites.outcome_blind_constraint: No population trend, abundance change, extinction, colonization or replacement outcome may be read.

collinearity_rule.tier2_richness_vs_shannon: If absolute Pearson r >= 0.8, retain Tier 2 richness as primary and Tier 2 Shannon only as sensitivity; otherwise both may remain separate predeclared summaries but are not entered together without standardization.
collinearity_rule.tier3_role: Tier 3 diversity is sensitivity only because Tier 3 embeds bioregional subdivision.
collinearity_rule.tier1_role: Tier 1 is broad environmental context only.

boundary: Habitat Complex richness is a site-centered breeding-option proxy, not occupied nesting habitat.
Raster classes are mapped ice-free terrestrial ecosystem classes, not penguin habitat suitability.
No trait selection uses penguin demographic outcomes.
